title: Google Family Link Usage Screen Time Leaderboard
dataSources: Canvas assignments (`canvas:assignment`), Khan Academy SAT practice (`khan:sat`), Family Link usage (`familylink:usage`), and OurHome chores (`ourhome:chore`).
app: Canvas LMS exports, Khan Academy SAT practice, Google Family Link screen-time data, and OurHome chore tracking streamed to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=familylink:usage screen_minutes=*
| stats sum(screen_minutes) as total_value, avg(screen_minutes) as avg_value by app_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks app name values by total and average screen time across Google Family Link usage events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `screen_minutes` values for each Google Family Link usage event and review total and average screen time by app name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total screen time.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which app name shows the biggest screen time numbers in your Google Family Link usage data.
